karty.priklad: Mae un anfantais fawr: y gost.
karty.priklad_cs: There's one big disadvantage: the cost (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine anfantais).
karty.mnemo: an- (dis-) + mantais (advantage): a disadvantage glows red like a stop light.

extra.pozn: manteision ac anfanteision = advantages and disadvantages; the prefix an- as in anhapus, anffodus; own example

karty.priklad: Enillodd Gareth gystadleuaeth gymnasteg fawr yng Nghaerdydd.
karty.priklad_cs: Gareth won a big gymnastics competition in Cardiff (cystadleuaeth → [g]ystadleuaeth as the object after enillodd; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine cystadleuaeth; Caerdydd → [Ngh]aerdydd after yng).
karty.mnemo: GYMNASTics (GYMNASTeg): a gymnast in a flame-red leotard.

extra.pozn: in the coursebook there is no mutation after the feminine cystadleuaeth or after maes (cystadleuaeth gymnasteg, ym maes gymnasteg); the book gives no plural; campfa = gym (outside the coursebook); sentence from p. 256

karty.priklad: Mae siarad Cymraeg yn fantais fawr yn y swydd yma.
karty.priklad_cs: Speaking Welsh is a big advantage in this job (mantais → [f]antais after yn; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine mantais).
karty.mnemo: The MANTle (MANT-ais) of a champion: the advantage of a warm scarlet cloak in winter.

extra.pozn: manteisio ar = to take advantage of (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r broses yn araf iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The process is very slow (proses → [b]roses after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: PROCESS (PROSES): it crawls along like bread in a slow toaster.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Des i a'r teulu i'ch syrcas yn Aberheli nos Wener.
karty.priklad_cs: My family and I came to your circus in Aberheli on Friday night (Gwener → [W]ener after nos).
karty.mnemo: CIRCUS (SYRCAS): a red big top and a fire-eater.

extra.pozn: s- doesn't take soft mutation (y syrcas); des i = I came (dod); sentence from the e-mail on p. 253

karty.priklad: Roedd cannoedd o feicwyr ar y ffordd.
karty.priklad_cs: There were hundreds of cyclists on the road (beicwyr → [f]eicwyr after o).
karty.mnemo: beic (bike) + -iwr (person): a cyclist pedalling through hailstones.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: synonym seiclwr (L11); in the coursebook also cystadleuaeth i feicwyr (p. 264); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n dod o gefndir Cymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She comes from a Welsh-speaking background (cefndir → [g]efndir after o).
karty.mnemo: cefn (back) + tir (land): the land behind you = the background, snow-capped mountains in the distance.

extra.pozn: cefndir is one of the topics of the oral interview (p. 265); tir (L11); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r tŷ ar gwr y goedwig.
karty.priklad_cs: The house is on the edge of the forest (cwr → [g]wr after ar; coedwig → [g]oedwig after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: A hen COOP (CWR) on the frozen edge of the wood.

extra.pozn: the plural cyrion is used mainly in ar gyrion = on the outskirts; own example

karty.priklad: Gwrandewch yn ofalus ar gwestiynau'r cyfwelydd.
karty.priklad_cs: Listen carefully to the interviewer's questions (cwestiynau → [g]westiynau after ar).
karty.mnemo: cyfweld (to interview) + -ydd (person): a frosty interviewer sipping a slush puppy.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: cyfweliad = interview (p. 265); sentence from p. 265

karty.priklad: Mae'r dyn yn gwadu pob cyhuddiad.
karty.priklad_cs: The man denies every charge.
karty.mnemo: cyhuddo = to accuse → cyhuddiad, a charge – read out in a freezing courtroom.

extra.pozn: cyhuddo = to accuse (outside the coursebook); gwadu = to deny (L7); also in the news glossary, p. 263; own example

karty.priklad: Mae ei gŵr hi'n wleidydd adnabyddus.
karty.priklad_cs: Her husband is a well-known politician (gwleidydd → [w]leidydd after 'n).
karty.mnemo: gwlad (country) + -ydd (person): a politician making a speech in front of an igloo.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: -ydd = person (note at arweinydd, L1); adnabyddus (L16); own example

karty.cs_upresneni: in a text or calculation, not camgymeriad
karty.priklad: Mae sawl gwall yn y llythyr.
karty.priklad_cs: There are several errors in the letter.
karty.mnemo: GWALL = GWALLT (hair) without the T: an error, like a hair stuck in your blue ice lolly.

extra.pozn: camgymeriad (L9) = mistake in general; gwall rather an error in a text or a calculation; own example

karty.priklad: Croeso i'r holl wrandawyr!
karty.priklad_cs: Welcome, all listeners! (gwrandawyr → [w]randawyr after holl)
karty.mnemo: gwrando (to listen) + -wr (person): a listener in fluffy earmuffs on a frosty night.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: the two dots over the a (didolnod) only in the singular, the plural gwrandawyr has none; own example

karty.priklad: Roedd cannoedd o brotestwyr y tu allan i'r Senedd.
karty.priklad_cs: There were hundreds of protestors outside the Senedd (protestwyr → [b]rotestwyr after o).
karty.mnemo: protest + -iwr (person): a protestor whose placard has frozen to his mittens.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: protest (f, L6), protestio (L11); plural protestwyr also in the e-mail on p. 254; own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd hi ei phenodi'n ysgrifennydd y clwb.
karty.priklad_cs: She was appointed secretary of the club (penodi → [ph]enodi after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: ysgrifennu (to write) + -ydd (person): a secretary typing in fingerless gloves in a freezing office.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: singular with nn, plural with one n; ysgrifennydd y clwb pêl-droed lleol (p. 258); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'n bwysig iawn taw chi sy'n arwain y sgwrs.
karty.priklad_cs: It's very important that you lead the conversation (literally: that it's you who leads the conversation; pwysig → [b]wysig after 'n).
karty.mnemo: arweinydd (conductor, leader, L1) = the one who leads.

extra.pozn: arweiniad = leadership, guidance (outside the coursebook); sentence from p. 251 (Sgwrs 5 munud)

sever.priklad: Mae'n bwysig iawn mai chi sy'n arwain y sgwrs.
sever.priklad_cs: It's very important that you lead the conversation.
sever.pozn: north: mai instead of taw (Y De a'r Gogledd, L14)

karty.priklad: Wnewch chi gadarnhau'r dyddiad, os gwelwch yn dda?
karty.priklad_cs: Would you confirm the date, please? (cadarnhau → [g]adarnhau after wnewch chi)
karty.mnemo: cadarn (firm) + -hau (to make): to confirm = to make firm.

extra.pozn: cadarn = firm, cadarnhad = confirmation (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd fy rhieni wedi'u cyffroi hefyd.
karty.priklad_cs: My parents were excited too (literally: had been excited).
karty.mnemo: cyffrous (exciting) → cyffroi = to excite.

extra.pozn: cyffrous = exciting, cyffro = excitement; wedi'u + verb = passive state (they); stem cyffro- (cyffrodd) to be checked; sentence from the e-mail on p. 253

karty.priklad: Penodwyd cadeirydd newydd am ddwy flynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: A new chair was appointed for two years (dwy → [dd]wy after am; blynedd → [f]lynedd after dwy; impersonal form -wyd, L12).
karty.mnemo: A memory aid: pen (head) + nodi (to note): note down who'll be the new head.

extra.pozn: penodiad = appointment (outside the coursebook); cadeirydd (L16); penodwyd is news register, colloquially Cafodd cadeirydd newydd ei benodi; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i bwysleisio un peth.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to emphasise one thing (pwysleisio → [b]wysleisio after hoffwn i).
karty.mnemo: pwys (weight) + llais (voice): to give your voice weight.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Bydd y stryd fawr yn llai diddorol a deniadol o achos hynny.
karty.priklad_cs: The high street will be less interesting and attractive because of that (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine stryd).
karty.mnemo: denu = to attract: a cosy DEN (DEN-iadol) is attractive.

extra.pozn: denu = to attract, to lure (outside the coursebook); sentence from the article on p. 252

karty.priklad: Mae'r ffatri'n cau achos y problemau economaidd yn y wlad.
karty.priklad_cs: The factory is closing because of the economic problems in the country (gwlad → [w]lad after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: From English ECONOMIC.

extra.pozn: economi (L10); the suffix -aidd as in twristaidd (L6); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: A bod yn onest, dw i ddim yn hoffi'r syrcas.
karty.priklad_cs: To be honest, I don't like the circus.
karty.mnemo: gonest ~ English honest; after yn the g- drops: yn onest.

extra.pozn: gonest → [–]onest after yn; a dweud y gwir = to tell the truth (close in meaning); own example

karty.cs: on a charge of, accused of
karty.priklad: Maen nhw yn y llys ar gyhuddiad o ddwyn pum mil o bunnau.
karty.priklad_cs: They are in court on a charge of stealing five thousand pounds (dwyn → [dd]wyn after o; punnau → [b]unnau after o).
karty.mnemo: cyhuddiad (charge) → gyhuddiad after ar: on a charge of.

extra.pozn: cyhuddiad → [g]yhuddiad after ar; the following word mutates because of o; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.cs: on the outskirts of, on the edge of
karty.priklad: Agorodd yr archfarchnad ar gyrion y dre ddwy flynedd yn ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: The supermarket opened on the outskirts of the town two years ago (tre → [d]re after y, feminine; dwy → [dd]wy in an expression of time).
karty.mnemo: cyrion = outskirts, edges (cwr = edge).

extra.pozn: cyrion = plural of cwr, soft mutation c → g after ar; sentence based on the article on p. 252

karty.priklad: Cawson nhw syrpréis yng Nghartref Henoed Hafod Deg.
karty.priklad_cs: They had a surprise in the Hafod Deg Old People's Home (Cartref → [Ngh]artref after yng).
karty.mnemo: cartref (home) + henoed (old people): a home for the elderly with rocking chairs along the corridor.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine (because of cartref), plural cartrefi henoed (outside the coursebook); henoed = old people, old age; sentence from the gap-fill exercise on p. 256 (cawson added)

karty.priklad: Cewch chi wneud pwyntiau bwled ar bapur ond dim sgript.
karty.priklad_cs: You may make bullet points on paper but no script (gwneud → [w]neud after cewch chi; papur → [b]apur after ar).
karty.mnemo: From English BULLET POINTS: pwynt (point) + bwled (bullet).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; plural only, gender not given; singular pwynt bwled; sentence from p. 265
